name: file-inspector-finder
description: Paseo plugin for Custom Voice & STT Models (SiliconFlow Free SenseVoiceSmall / OpenWhispr Qwen3-ASR / Gemini 6-Key Pool), Schedule Runs History & 1-Click Session Drill-Down (⌘⇧H & inline Runs pills), Project Workspace Quick Switcher (Cmd+J / Cmd+Shift+O), zero-popup double-click & F2 inline rename, sidebar folder drag-and-drop workspace import, colored thread labels, Finder/Explorer reveal, macOS Preview/Editor launch, and image metadata inspection.
